comment: Third-party files ARM-DOS's disks carry but the repository does not. tools/fetch-3rdparty.sh downloads each item's archives into 3rdparty/downloads/ and unpacks the files into 3rdparty/<dst>; every download and every file is sha256-checked. urls: the first that works is used. path: how to get the file out of the download (zip:, lha:, shr: members, nested left to right; [] = the download itself). derive: a command that makes the file from the download.

items.title: DOOM shareware v1.9 (DOOM1.WAD, id Software, 1995)
items.licence: id Software shareware: may be copied and given away free of charge, not sold. See apps/doom/README.md.

items.licence: id Software shareware licence (SLICNSE.TXT): the unmodified shareware release may be copied and distributed free of charge. See apps/quake/README.md.

items.licence: 3D Realms shareware licence (LICENSE.TXT): the unmodified shareware episode may be distributed free of charge. See apps/duke3d/README.md.

items.title: Wolfenstein 3D shareware v1.4 (id Software / Apogee, 1993)
items.licence: Apogee shareware licence (VENDOR.DOC): the unmodified shareware episode may be copied and given away. See apps/wolf3d/README.md.

items.title: Keen Dreams shareware v1.13 (Softdisk / id Software, 1992)
items.licence: Softdisk shareware licence (LICENSE.DOC, VENDOR.DOC inside the zip): BBS sysops may offer the unmodified zip for download. On ARM-DOS it is only on the in-machine BBS. See apps/keen/README.md.

items.licence: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 (CC BY 4.0), Kevin MacLeod. See apps/cdrom/disc/music/tracks.json.

items.licence: The Unlicense (public domain), released by Future Crew in 2013 (UNLICENS.TXT). See apps/secondreality/README.md.
items.notes: GitHub builds the zip on the fly, so only the unpacked files are hash-checked.
